series: Climate Fiscal Policy Briefs · Section 1: Carbon Pricing · October 2026
title: Price Production and Consumption Separately

slides.title: Price Production and Consumption Separately
slides.subtitle: Carbon pricing in open economies: section 1 in ten slides
slides.message: One carbon price does two jobs, and in an open economy the second undermines the first. Give each job its own instrument: a feebate for production, a destination charge for consumption, credit for the price signal at the border, and one yardstick for all of it.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
